newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia c/account shows weak economy - oppn.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia c/account shows weak economy - oppn.

text.p: Australian opposition Treasury spokesman Gareth Evans said on Wednesday the current account deficit outcome for September showed the government was delivering a weak economy and a rising current account deficit.
"The government promised it would deliver a stronger economy and a lower current account deficit," Evans said in a statement.
Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.690 billion in September from August's deficit of A$1.470 billion, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Evans said the figures also showed a deteriorating outlook for business investment.
"The sharp slowing in capital imports indicates that Australian businesses are putting off their investment plans because the economy is weaker than expected," he said.
